headline: Midland County Power Backup Report
summary: Homes in Midland County face a long outage about once every 13 years. This comes from 8 years of records since 2018. In February 2021, 28% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 65 hours. In May 2024, 7% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 23 hours. One Core lasts about 16 hours in August. One Core lasts about 35 hours in November. Two Cores last about 25 hours in August. Two Cores cover 95% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours for gas heat and a larger footprint homes in Midland County. Base confirms sizing at install.
